욥기 7:1.content: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

욥기 7:2.content: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

욥기 7:3.content: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

욥기 7:4.content: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

욥기 7:5.content: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

욥기 7:6.content: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

욥기 7:7.content: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

욥기 7:8.content: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

욥기 7:9.content: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

욥기 7:10.content: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

욥기 7:11.content: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

욥기 7:12.content: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

욥기 7:13.content: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

욥기 7:14.content: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

욥기 7:15.content: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

욥기 7:16.content: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

욥기 7:17.content: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

욥기 7:18.content: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

욥기 7:19.content: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

욥기 7:20.content: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

욥기 7:21.content: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
